intent.proves: At least one active shipping method names products or product groups in its product filter.
intent.scope: all active shipping methods; the filter mode is reported, not interpreted

bindings.reason: get_shipping_methods does not establish the product filter fields in its DTO.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomShippings s WHERE s.ShippingActive = 1 AND (ISNULL(s.ShippingProductIds, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(s.ShippingProductGroupIds, N'') <> N'')

sources.ref: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS on a 10.29.8 install (read-only): dbo.EcomShippings.ShippingProductIds, ShippingProductGroupIds, ShippingProductFilterMode
